en-US.description: A Fleet Management Service for monitoring Global Merchant Fleet vessel position using satellite and terrestrial AIS and Captain’s Report.
en-US.longDescription: Netpas Vessel Monitor AIS is a Fleet Management Service for monitoring Global Merchant Fleet vessel position using satellite and terrestrial AIS and Captain’s Report. It is more than a real-time vessel tracking service but also manages your vessels from chartering to operation. NVM AIS is suitable for the users who want to monitor vessel's movement with minimum information. And it's more useful for the users who want to analyze and build up the record of the voyage and vessel performance. Simply find your vessel and start monitoring using Netpas AIS. Netpas will analyze and update the vessels' positions through map with details such as current ROB, ETA, and etc. Furthermore, NVM AIS produces and saves the detailed Voyage Report as well as Fleet Status Reports automatically for your efficient vessel management.
en-US.name: Netpas Vessel Monitor AIS

zh-CN.description: 全球商船队管理服务，使用卫星和地面 AIS 及船长报告监控船舶位置
zh-CN.longDescription: Netpas Vessel Monitor AIS 系统是一款全球商船队管理服务，通过卫星/地面 AIS 信号及船长报告实现船舶定位。这不仅是实时船舶追踪服务，更提供从租船到运营的全周期管理。NVM AIS 既适合只需基础船舶动态监控的用户，更能满足需要分析航次记录与船舶性能的深度需求。通过 Netpas AIS 快速定位目标船舶即可开启监控，系统将通过地图实时更新船舶位置，并显示当前燃油存量、预计到港时间等关键数据。此外，NVM AIS 还能自动生成并存储详尽的航次报告与船队状态报告，助您实现高效船舶管理。
